design: Enumerate16binary patterns per input with frozen H691 seed11 representation and identical H692 data. Compare exact per-example minima with H692 learned gates at cost0.01. Other costs are diagnostic sweeps, not heldout tuning. Teacher gate labels only evaluated after selecting by reconstruction plus group count.
limitations: Exact conditional inference only; fixed dictionary learned with teacher gates; enumeration does not scale to many groups; sweep exploratory.
